title: Cracked embankment above our village
body_original: हमारे गाँव के ऊपर जो बाँध है उसमें बड़ी दरार आ गई है। पिछली बरसात में पानी रिसने लगा था। अगर यह टूट गया तो नीचे के तीस घर बह जाएँगे। हमने मुखिया जी को बताया लेकिन कुछ नहीं हुआ।
body_en: There is a large crack in the embankment above our village. Water started seeping through it during the last monsoon. If it breaks, the thirty houses below will be washed away. We told the mukhiya but nothing happened.

title: Handpump water turns yellow after rain
body_original: Every year after the first heavy rain the water from our handpump turns yellow and smells. Children get stomach illness for two or three weeks. We boil it but firewood is expensive. There is no other source in this tola.

title: Ground sinking near the old mine
body_original: हमारे मोहल्ले में जमीन धीरे-धीरे धँस रही है। दो घरों की दीवारों में दरारें आ गई हैं। यहाँ पुरानी कोयला खदान बंद पड़ी है। रात में आवाज आती है।
body_en: The ground in our neighbourhood is slowly sinking. Cracks have appeared in the walls of two houses. There is an old closed coal mine here. We hear sounds at night.

title: Smoke from underground fire reaches the school
body_original: There is smoke coming out of the ground about two hundred metres from the primary school. On still days the children cough badly and the teacher sends them home. This has been happening for years and it is getting worse.

title: No drinking water after March every year
body_original: हर साल मार्च के बाद हमारे गाँव का कुआँ सूख जाता है। औरतों को तीन किलोमीटर दूर से पानी लाना पड़ता है। गर्मी में यह बहुत मुश्किल हो जाता है।
body_en: Every year after March the well in our village dries up. The women have to bring water from three kilometres away. In the summer heat this becomes very hard.

title: Road washes away every monsoon
body_original: The approach road to our village is cut off for about six weeks every monsoon because the stream crossing has no culvert. A pregnant woman had to be carried on a cot last July. We have asked for a culvert for eight years.

title: River is eating the field boundary
body_original: नदी हर साल हमारे खेत का किनारा काट रही है। पिछले पाँच साल में लगभग बीस फीट जमीन चली गई। अब घर से सिर्फ पचास फीट दूर है।
body_en: The river cuts away the edge of our field every year. In the last five years roughly twenty feet of land has gone. Now it is only fifty feet from the house.

title: Forest fire comes close to houses every February
body_original: Every February a fire starts in the forest on the hill behind us and comes within a few hundred metres of the houses. Last year it burned the mahua trees we collect from. There is no fire line and nobody to call.

title: Anganwadi has no shade and children faint in May
body_original: मई में आंगनबाड़ी केंद्र के पास कोई छाया नहीं है। छत टीन की है और अंदर बहुत गर्मी हो जाती है। पिछले साल दो बच्चे बेहोश हो गए थे।
body_en: There is no shade near the anganwadi centre in May. The roof is tin and it becomes very hot inside. Last year two children fainted.

title: Fluoride in the borewell water
body_original: The water from the new borewell has been tested once and we were told it has fluoride. Several older people here have joint pain and some children have yellow marks on their teeth. Nobody came back after the test.

title: Landslide blocks the road to the block office
body_original: बरसात में पहाड़ी से मिट्टी और पत्थर गिरकर सड़क बंद कर देते हैं। ब्लॉक ऑफिस जाने का यही एक रास्ता है। पिछली बार दस दिन तक रास्ता बंद रहा।
body_en: During the rains soil and stones fall from the hillside and block the road. This is the only route to the block office. Last time the road was closed for ten days.

title: Malaria every rainy season in the same three tolas
body_original: Every rainy season the same three tolas get malaria. The ASHA didi says the breeding is in the abandoned quarry pits that fill with water. Nobody has drained them or put fish in them.

title: Stagnant water in front of the health sub centre
body_original: स्वास्थ्य उपकेंद्र के सामने बरसात का पानी महीनों जमा रहता है। मरीजों को पानी में से होकर जाना पड़ता है। मच्छर बहुत हो गए हैं।
body_en: Rainwater collects in front of the health sub centre for months. Patients have to wade through it. There are a lot of mosquitoes now.

title: Crops fail because rain stops in August
body_original: For the last four years the rain has stopped in the middle of August and the paddy has failed. We do not have an irrigation channel here. Many young men have gone to Surat to work.

title: School building has cracks after the blasting
body_original: स्कूल की दीवारों में दरारें आ गई हैं। पास की खदान में ब्लास्टिंग होती है तो पूरा भवन हिलता है। बच्चे डर जाते हैं।
body_en: Cracks have appeared in the school walls. When there is blasting at the nearby quarry the whole building shakes. The children get frightened.

title: Drain overflows into the street every week
body_original: The main drain in our ward overflows into the street nearly every week because it is choked with plastic. The waste water stands in front of the shops. Two shopkeepers have had skin problems.

title: Elephants come through the village at night
body_original: रात में हाथी गाँव से होकर गुजरते हैं और फसल बर्बाद कर देते हैं। पिछले साल एक आदमी की मौत हो गई थी। कोई चेतावनी व्यवस्था नहीं है।
body_en: Elephants pass through the village at night and destroy the crops. Last year a man died. There is no warning system.

title: No cold storage so vegetables rot before the market
body_original: We grow tomatoes and brinjal but there is no cold storage within forty kilometres. In the peak season we sell at whatever price we get or throw them away. Nearly a third of the crop is lost.

title: Old people cannot reach the ration shop
body_original: राशन की दुकान गाँव से दो किलोमीटर दूर है और रास्ता खराब है। बुजुर्ग और दिव्यांग लोग वहाँ नहीं पहुँच पाते। उन्हें किसी और को भेजना पड़ता है।
body_en: The ration shop is two kilometres from the village and the path is bad. Elderly and disabled people cannot reach it. They have to send somebody else.

title: Pond bund breached and irrigation stopped
body_original: The bund of the community pond breached three monsoons ago and has not been repaired. The pond no longer holds water through the winter so the second crop has stopped on about forty acres.

title: Toilet built but no water so nobody uses it
body_original: शौचालय बन तो गया है लेकिन पानी की कोई व्यवस्था नहीं है। इसलिए लोग उसका इस्तेमाल नहीं करते। ज्यादातर घरों में यही हाल है।
body_en: The toilet has been built but there is no water arrangement. So people do not use it. It is the same in most houses.

title: Low cost iron removal filter for handpumps
body_original: The water from our handpumps has so much iron that it stains clothes and tastes of metal. A student team from the university made a simple filter with local materials and it has been working for a year now.

title: Culvert built after four years of asking
body_original: चार साल माँगने के बाद आखिरकार पुलिया बन गई। अब बरसात में भी गाँव कटता नहीं है। बच्चे स्कूल जा पा रहे हैं।
body_en: After four years of asking the culvert has finally been built. Now the village is not cut off even during the rains. The children are able to go to school.
